items.reason: Not a defect claim. The statement is true: app/routes/index.js:55-56 mount isLoggedIn then isAdmin on GET and POST /benefits. GT classifies AC-1 as CLOSED (fix applied).
Behaviour described is true (app/routes/session.js:28 and :32 redirect to /login, no 403), but GT classifies this as AC-2, CLOSED (OVER-RATED, informational), so it is not a defect.

app/routes/allocations.js:16-18 take userId from req.params and pass it to the DAO at :23; the route has only isLoggedIn (app/routes/index.js:59); the DAO filters on that id (app/data/allocations-dao.js:58, :81-83) and adds the user's names (:94-99). IDOR as described.

Not a defect claim. True: memos are inserted without owner (app/data/memos-dao.js:18-21) and read globally (:28, called at app/routes/memos.js:25). GT lists memos as a candidate not included (shared board by design).
Not a defect claim. True: app/routes/tutorial.js:8-37 render fixed templates from a fixed list with only environmentalScripts. GT: /tutorial/* public on purpose (candidate not included).
Not a defect claim. True: app/routes/profile.js:14-16 and :78-80 take userId from req.session only. GT lists this among checks that hold.
Not a defect claim. True: app/routes/contributions.js:13-15 and :42-44 take userId from req.session only. GT lists this among checks that hold.

Not a defect claim. True: app/routes/session.js:28 calls next only when user && user.isAdmin, otherwise redirects; a failed lookup leaves user undefined. GT lists this fail-closed behaviour among checks that hold.

app/routes/session.js:116 sets req.session.userId on the existing session without req.session.regenerate, while signup regenerates (:234-235); saveUninitialized: true at server.js:84 issues the id before login. The hedge about exploitability does not change that the described defect exists; GT-2 is OPEN.
Not a defect claim. True: app/routes/profile.js:42-50 destructure seven named fields and app/data/profile-dao.js:45-81 $set only those. GT: no mass assignment to isAdmin.
Not a defect claim. True: /dashboard (app/routes/index.js:44) uses displayWelcomePage, which reads req.session.userId (app/routes/session.js:259-266).
Not a defect claim. True: / (app/routes/index.js:30) redirects when no session user and otherwise uses req.session.userId (app/routes/session.js:259-266), as in the GT route map.
Not a defect claim. True: /logout (app/routes/index.js:41) destroys the session (app/routes/session.js:121-123); no access-control defect.
app/routes/index.js:68 does res.redirect(req.query.url): open redirect as described. GT classifies it as adjacent (ADJ-6).
app/routes/research.js:15 builds url from req.query.url + req.query.symbol and :16 fetches it with needle.get: SSRF as described. GT classifies it as adjacent (ADJ-7).

app/data/allocations-dao.js:78 interpolates threshold into the $where string; a payload such as 1'; return 1 == '1 returns every user's rows, and it survives a session-based userId fix. GT classifies it as adjacent (ADJ-1).
app/routes/contributions.js:32-34 eval req.body.preTax/afterTax/roth: SSJS injection as described. GT classifies it as adjacent (ADJ-8).

Read as an XSS concern on memo rendering. app/views/memos.html:31 outputs marked(doc.memo) unescaped (autoescape: false at server.js:137); marked is pinned to 0.3.5 (package.json) whose sanitize option (server.js:126-128) is bypassable with javascript&#58 links, as the bundled app/views/tutorial/a9.html:156-163 shows. Stored XSS through memos is GT ADJ-5 (memos listed as an output point).

Not a defect claim. The static part is true: app/routes/index.js:55-56 carry isLoggedIn and isAdmin; BenefitsDAO is used only by app/routes/benefits.js; app/data/profile-dao.js:42-81 cannot set benefitStartDate. The live-request part was not verified (running is not allowed). GT classifies AC-1 as CLOSED.
Behaviour described is true (app/routes/session.js:28 and :32 redirect instead of 403), but GT classifies this as AC-2, CLOSED (OVER-RATED, informational).

app/routes/allocations.js:16-18 take userId from req.params, used at :23; route guarded only by isLoggedIn (app/routes/index.js:59); signup is open (app/routes/index.js:38); DAO filters on that id and adds names (app/data/allocations-dao.js:58, :81-83, :94-99). IDOR as described.

app/data/allocations-dao.js:78 places threshold raw inside the $where string; a crafted value makes the predicate true for all rows and :94-99 attach each user's names; a session-based userId fix leaves it open. GT classifies it as adjacent (ADJ-1).

Not a defect claim. True: operator objects in userName reach findOne (app/data/user-dao.js:91-93, JSON parser at server.js:71), but comparePassword uses === (app/data/user-dao.js:61, :75), so an object password never matches and no login bypass follows. Live test not verified.

Not a defect claim. True: app/routes/session.js:191-198 destructure six named fields; app/data/user-dao.js:20-36 build the document field by field and :38-44 take _id from the counter, so isAdmin and _id cannot be set. GT: no mass assignment to isAdmin.

Not a defect claim. True: app/routes/profile.js:42-50 take seven named fields, :78-83 use the session userId, app/data/profile-dao.js:45-81 $set only those fields filtered on that _id. GT lists this among checks that hold.
Not a defect claim. True: app/routes/contributions.js:13-15 and :42-44 take userId from req.session; no body userId is read. GT lists this among checks that hold.
Not a defect claim. True: app/data/memos-dao.js:18-21 store no owner and :28 reads all. GT lists memos as a candidate not included (shared board by design).
Not a defect claim. True: app/routes/index.js:30 mounts / without isLoggedIn and app/routes/session.js:259-262 redirect to /login when there is no session user, as in the GT route map.

Not a defect claim (it says no takeover or privilege gain follows). True: app/routes/session.js:208 checks the name and :220 inserts later, so a race can create duplicate names, but each record gets its own counter _id (app/data/user-dao.js:38-44) and the session binds to that _id (app/routes/session.js:235), so no access to another account follows.

Not a defect claim. True: app/routes/session.js:28 calls next only for user && user.isAdmin; an error or missing user leaves user falsy and redirects. GT lists this fail-closed behaviour among checks that hold.
app/routes/contributions.js:32-34 eval body fields on POST /contributions, reachable by any signed-in user (app/routes/index.js:52). GT classifies it as adjacent (ADJ-8).

app/data/user-dao.js:92 uses req.body.userName (app/routes/session.js:54-58) as the filter value, and bodyParser.json() (server.js:71) lets objects such as {"$regex": ...} through, so operators reach the query. Impact is limited (no login bypass because of === at app/data/user-dao.js:61), but it allows selecting users by pattern and, with the distinct messages, prefix enumeration. Not listed in GT.
app/routes/research.js:15-16 build a URL from req.query.url + req.query.symbol and fetch it server-side. GT classifies it as adjacent (ADJ-7).
app/routes/index.js:68 redirects to req.query.url: open redirect. GT classifies it as adjacent (ADJ-6).
app/routes/profile.js:59 defines /([0-9]+)+\#/ (nested quantifier) and :61 tests bankRouting from the body with it: catastrophic backtracking on long digit strings without '#'. Not listed in GT.
app/routes/session.js:116 sets req.session.userId without req.session.regenerate (the fix is only in the comment at :104-115). GT-2 is OPEN.
app/routes/session.js:85 returns 'Invalid username' and :94 'Invalid password': user enumeration. GT classifies it as adjacent (ADJ-9).
app/data/user-dao.js:25 stores password as received (bcrypt fix commented out at :26-30). GT classifies it as adjacent (ADJ-9).

server.js:78-102 pass no cookie options. Per the GT correction the httpOnly half is wrong (express-session ^1.13.0, package.json:14, defaults httpOnly: true), but the missing secure flag (and maxAge) stands, so the cookie defect exists. GT classifies it as adjacent (ADJ-3).
server.js:104-113 leave csurf commented out (app.use(csrf()) at :107); no token on state-changing POSTs. GT classifies it as adjacent (ADJ-2).
config/env/all.js:8 hardcodes cookieSecret; no env file overrides it (config/env/production.js is empty; config/config.js:10 only merges). GT classifies it as adjacent (ADJ-3).
server.js:135-142 set swig autoescape: false (line 137). GT classifies it as adjacent (ADJ-5).

app/views/memos.html:31 emits marked(doc.memo) with template autoescape off (server.js:137). marked's sanitize: true (server.js:126-128) escapes raw HTML, but marked 0.3.5 is bypassable with javascript&#58 links (app/views/tutorial/a9.html:156-163), so stored XSS through memos holds. GT ADJ-5 (memos listed as an output point).

app/routes/allocations.js:16-18 and :26 pass the decoded path param to the view, and app/views/allocations.html:15 writes it into the form action unescaped (autoescape off, server.js:137). parseInt at app/data/allocations-dao.js:58 accepts a leading number (e.g. 1"><script>...), so the page still renders: reflected XSS. A session-based userId would remove the source. Covered by GT ADJ-5 (reflected XSS from autoescape off).
app/data/profile-dao.js:61-66 store ssn and dob as given (encryption only in the comments at :15-40 and :67-76). Not listed in GT.
Not a defect claim. True: app/routes/index.js:75 mounts /tutorial without middleware and app/routes/tutorial.js renders fixed templates. GT: public on purpose (candidate not included).
Not a defect claim. True: app/routes/index.js:33-41 mount /login, /signup, /logout without middleware; server.js:68 (favicon) and :121 (express.static) are public, consistent with the GT route map.
Not a defect claim. True: app/routes/index.js:44, 47-48, 51-52, 59, 62-63, 66, 72 all carry isLoggedIn.

Not a defect claim. Largely true: /dashboard, /profile, /contributions use the session id; /memos, /learn, /research have no per-user record. Literal exception: /benefits takes userId from the body (app/routes/benefits.js:30-35), which GT treats as the intended admin function behind isAdmin (app/routes/index.js:55-56).
Not a defect claim. True: app/routes/session.js:36-42 call next only when req.session.userId is set; it is set only after validateLogin succeeds (:116) or after signup (:235).

Not a defect claim. True for normal use: /dashboard, /profile, /contributions use the session id and do not branch on isAdmin, and the menu links to the admin's own id (app/views/layout.html:56). Not strictly true as stated, since through GT-1 (app/routes/allocations.js:16-18) the admin, like any user, can read other users' allocations.

Not a defect claim. True: middleware is attached per route in app/routes/index.js, and Express's default case-insensitive, non-strict routing and GET-for-HEAD handling resolve variants to the same route chain.
Not a defect claim. True: server.js:121 mounts express.static on app/assets only (favicon from the same folder at :68).

notes: Zone reading: access control in the Express routes, the isLoggedIn/isAdmin middleware, the handlers and DAOs behind them, and the session (route reachability, ownership, admin checks, mass assignment, session binding). Items GT places under 'Adjacent to the zone' (injection, SSRF, open redirect, CSRF, XSS, cookie configuration, transport, weak authentication) are out of zone, as is anything of that kind not in GT (ReDoS, data at rest, NoSQL operator injection in login). Claims that something holds, on an access-control topic, count as in zone.

Claims that a check or fix holds, or that something is not a defect, are graded NOT REAL; the reason says whether the statement is true. All such statements in these lists are true, except the literal exception noted in B-31 (/benefits takes userId from the body by design) and the 'not strictly' caveat in B-33.
AC-1 (benefits fix, A-1, B-1) and AC-2 (redirect instead of 403, A-2, B-2) follow GT: both CLOSED, so NOT REAL; the behaviour A-2/B-2 describe is accurate but GT rates it informational.
Hedged A-9 ('may allow session fixation ... left open') graded REAL as GT-2: the code at app/routes/session.js:116 has the described missing regeneration.
Hand-off items ('passed on ... without a decision / without being checked') are graded REAL when the code holds the defect they name.

A-18 is vague (it only says memos are rendered through marked). Read as the implied XSS on memo rendering; graded REAL and mapped to ADJ-5 because GT lists memos as an output point of the autoescape-off XSS; the marked 0.3.5 sanitize bypass is documented in the fixture's own tutorial a9.html.

B-21 partially wrong: per the GT correction, express-session ^1.13.0 defaults httpOnly to true, so the httpOnly half is not a defect; the missing secure flag (and maxAge) stands, so graded REAL as ADJ-3. Physical line server.js:78 opens the session options object that omits the cookie options; counted as holding the omission.

B-14 borderline: operator objects do reach findOne, but with === password comparison there is no bypass (as B-5 says). Graded REAL (low impact: pattern-based user selection and prefix enumeration with the distinct login messages), outside GT.

B-26: reflected XSS through the allocations path param is reachable because parseInt accepts a leading digit, so allocations are found and the view renders; mapped to ADJ-5 (GT covers reflected XSS from autoescape off).

A-18 and B-25 cite the sink app/views/memos.html:31 rather than GT's server.js autoescape line or memos.js:13; the sink line is where the unescaped memo output happens, so the location is counted as holding the defect.
Live-test parts of claims (B-1, B-3, B-5, B-6, B-7, B-8) could not be checked, since running the application is not allowed; grading rests on the code.

B-5 and B-14 put out of zone (login lookup injection / authentication, the same class as ADJ-1 and ADJ-9); B-11 kept in zone (the question is account takeover or privilege gain in the signup handler).
Besides the list, the ground truth and the base checkout, only files inside the base were read (including app/views/tutorial/a9.html and config/env/*.js).
